headline: Fisherman's Row Turns to Wardens; Weathered Expanse Heaviest Fighting
war_summary: Weathered Expanse remains the loudest sector on the map, nine events filed in the last two hours and fifty-five across the day, the latest at this hour; Crow's Nest and Frostmarch stay the busiest points. Since the last edition the Warden footing there has slipped from four bases to two, Colonials now holding seven, with casualties running into the thousands on both sides. Fisherman's Row has swung sharply the other way: six bases there have been taken by Warden forces in the past day, the region now reading five Warden to four Colonial, with six events in two hours around Eidolo, Black Well and Oceanwatch. Callahan's Passage, quiet at the previous filing, has broken out again with eight events in two hours, chiefly at The Crumbling Passage, Wardens holding eight bases to two. Mooring County stays contested at Wiccwalk, Wardens holding eleven of twelve. Stema Landing has flared anew, four events in two hours at The Flair, Colonials holding eight of nine. Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf have gone quiet after brisk work earlier in the day. Colonials retain the great majority of the map; Warden colours fly over fourteen whole regions, and enlistments remain brisk in the contested sectors.
